database_schema.summary: App lưu: user/auth, local và cloud media libraries, metadata anime/movie/series, watch progress, subtitles, HDR/DV metadata per file, scheduled tasks, app version info, và pretranscode queue.
database_schema.migration_035_media_file_hdr_metadata: Added 4 columns to media_files: is_hdr INTEGER, dv_profile INTEGER (0=none, 5=IPT-PQ-C2, 7=dual-layer, 8=single-layer BL+RPU), color_transfer TEXT, color_primaries TEXT. Defaults all 0/empty for existing rows — scanner populates on fresh scan. Runtime reads DVProfile from DB (safe under flag gate); IsHDR stays runtime-probed to avoid unmigrated-row regression.
database_schema.migration_036_storage_providers: Added storage_providers table for encrypted cloud account credentials and provider metadata.
database_schema.migration_037_cloud_libraries: Libraries can now point to storage_provider_id + source_url for cloud-backed scanning and playback.
database_schema.migration_040_live_tv: live_playlists + live_channels tables for IPTV M3U import.
database_schema.migration_041_epg_url: Added epg_url column to live_playlists for XMLTV source.
database_schema.migration_043_live_channels_hidden: is_hidden flag per channel to soft-hide without re-import.
database_schema.migration_044_live_channel_headers: Stores custom HTTP headers (User-Agent, Referer) per channel for IPTV upstream auth.
database_schema.migration_045_user_live_channel_data: Per-user recently-watched tracking for live TV. Table (user_id, channel_id, play_count, last_watched_at, updated_at) mirrors media user_data. Populated from handleStreamEntry proxy with a 5-min cooldown. Index idx_ulcd_recent on (user_id, last_watched_at DESC).

business_rules: Marker detection triggers a background task and broadcasts progress to admins via websocket.
Admin features like backfilling markers are guarded by admin checks in both frontend apps.
Direct Play first; HLS/transcode only when codec/container/audio incompatible.
Keep screen on while video is playing or locked; allow screen off when paused.
Stream URL TTL (expires_in) is calculated from media file duration, not fixed.
Scheduled tasks persist to SQLite tasks table. Intervals are configurable from admin UI.
Cloud-backed playback must resolve CDN URLs as late as possible because provider URLs can expire or rotate between session creation and FFmpeg restart.
cloud-media-probe scheduler is deliberately throttled to one probe every 3 seconds and should stop the current run immediately on provider rate limit.
When user selects a non-default audio track for HLS playback, the exact track ID must be preserved across web, Android, and backend session naming.
HDR tonemapping default: tonemapx SW (Jellyfin SIMD) — handles HDR10, HLG, DV Profile 5 correctly.

HW HDR tonemapping (VELOX_HW_TONEMAP=true, opt-in): VAAPI uses tonemap_vaapi (driver-default algorithm, format/matrix/primaries/transfer only). NVENC uses libplacebo on Vulkan (SW decode → Vulkan upload → hwdownload → NVENC).
DV Profile 5 (IPT-PQ-C2) ALWAYS falls back to SW tonemapx — hardware tonemappers do not understand IPT color space.
DV Profile 7/8 unlocked via hevc_metadata=remove_dovi=1 BSF (input-side) — strips DV RPU, HDR10 base goes to HW tonemap.

Scanner extracts HDR/DV side_data + color tags into media_files columns on first scan. Force rescan does NOT re-probe fingerprint match early-return files — metadata refresh is a deliberate admin action.

When downloading content from Cloud to NAS, the worker pushes locally saved files exclusively to `dataDir/library/downloads` and updates the media_files `file_path` flag to point to the local instance, guaranteeing prevention of duplication upon subsequent library scans.
DownloadSeries endpoints enqueue tasks into a buffered channel of size 2000 so processing happens synchronously one by one, mitigating provider 429 scale-oriented ratelimits.
Live TV recently-watched tracking is driven by the stream proxy (handleStreamEntry), not by an explicit client call, so every platform (web/Android/TV) gets it for free.
Recently-watched bump is throttled via in-memory 5-min cooldown per (user_id, channel_id) to avoid inflating play_count from HLS segment re-requests and rapid channel-surfing.
DeleteDownloadedFile only removes files whose path is inside DownloadService.outputDir AND not a cloud:// scheme — protects against accidentally deleting the original library file when paths overlap.
Episode payloads are hydrated with `media_files` so the UI can decide between Download-to-NAS vs Delete-local-download per episode without a second round-trip.
features: Android TV App (Jetpack Compose for TV)
HW HDR Tonemapping (VAAPI + NVENC libplacebo, opt-in VELOX_HW_TONEMAP)
DV Profile 7/8 BSF Passthrough (zero-copy HW tonemap via hevc_metadata=remove_dovi=1)
Recently Watched Channels (Live TV — cross-platform home row backed by user_live_channel_data)
Delete Local NAS Downloads (per-media DELETE + per-series bulk DELETE, with confirm dialog on Web/Android)

patterns: Use ViewModel to bind Jetpack Compose state.
Grid layouts use GridCells.Adaptive(minSize=100.dp). LazyRow items use fixed dp sizes with responsive breakpoints.
Phone vs tablet breakpoint: screenWidthDp < 600 = phone.
LucideIcons object is a thin alias layer over Material Icons Rounded.
VideoPlayer gesture hierarchy: root pointerInput when controls hidden, controls overlay handles own events.
In-app updates: DownloadManager + REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES + Intent.ACTION_VIEW.
Scheduled tasks persist to SQLite 'tasks' table with configurable intervals.
Cloud playback sessions should capture a resolver closure, not a resolved URL string, so every FFmpeg start/restart can fetch a fresh provider URL.
HLS audio selection should use exact track ID in the session key/prefix and client state; language alone is not stable enough.
For HLS selected audio, use the multi-output path even with one chosen track so FFmpeg maps the correct source stream instead of always falling back to 0:a:0.
Android pull-to-refresh pattern: expose isRefreshing in UI state and wrap the scroll container with Material3 PullToRefreshBox.
Web HLS stability pattern: cache the last resolved HLS URL in a ref and skip destroy/recreate when the URL itself did not change.
HDR tonemapping: tonemapx filter for ALL paths. Scale filter AFTER tonemap for HDR.
HDR decode: Always software decode for HDR content. HW decoders strip color metadata.
DV detection: IsHDRLike() via color tags + side_data + filename. NeedsHDRColorMetadataFallback() for DV P5.
AI Translation: For reasoning models, disable <thinking> blocks, bump MaxTokens=8192 and HTTP Timeout=180s.
Docker Build: Use BuildKit --mount=type=cache for pnpm/go/apt/pip. Prefer Debian slim over Alpine (musl libc penalty).
Dynamic Locale in Compose: Wrap LocalContext with ContextWrapper overriding getResources(). Do NOT replace LocalContext with ConfigurationContext directly.
HW tonemap probe pattern: eager non-blocking goroutine at server startup (ProbeTonemapCapabilitiesAsync); atomic.Bool flags for runtime lookup.
DV Profile 7/8 BSF: Add '-bsf:v:0 hevc_metadata=remove_dovi=1' as INPUT-side option (before -i). Strips DV RPU so HDR10 base layer feeds HW tonemap cleanly.
Using Non-blocking API requests for sequential batching jobs. Handlers can just queue elements to background channel `queue <- task`, letting Go handle the iteration independently of HTTP timeouts.

For ExoPlayer / native HLS players, authenticate via Jellyfin-style `?token=<jwt>` query param instead of Authorization header — Media3 DefaultHttpDataSource cannot easily inject headers per-segment, and the auth middleware already honors `token` before falling back to JWT header.

MediaSessionService lifecycle: always pair ensureServiceStarted() with stopService() in the player-release path. Otherwise the service lingers, keeping a stale MediaSession and producing a leftover notification that bleeds into subsequent screens (e.g. Live TV).

Universal Android APK for phone + TV: declare both MainActivity (LAUNCHER) and TvMainActivity (LEANBACK_LAUNCHER) in AndroidManifest, then set uses-feature leanback/touchscreen required="false". No separate TV variant needed.

Service interface extraction (e.g., SettingsServiceInterface) is opt-in for testability — only extract when there is a concrete consumer (a handler test) that needs to mock it. Avoid speculative interfaces that double the surface area for no reason.
Toast.error supports an optional second `detail` arg (`error('msg', err.message)`) — UI shows them concatenated. Use it whenever surfacing a backend error to the user.

Always invoke ffmpeg via ffmpegbin.FFmpeg() instead of bare `"ffmpeg"` — keeps the resolved binary consistent with the rest of the transcode pipeline (jellyfin-ffmpeg in Docker, system ffmpeg locally).
gotchas: Android app lacks websocket implementation; polling/fire-and-forget for background tasks.
Do NOT use dynamic relative width inside LazyRow — hides scroll affordance.
Nested Scaffolds cause double status bar padding — outer needs contentWindowInsets=WindowInsets(0).
SliderDefaults.Track renders a stop indicator by default — pass drawStopIndicator=null.
Root pointerInput detectDragGestures intercepts Slider drag — skip when controls visible.
FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON must be tied to isPlaying to prevent timeout during playback.
Double subtitle rendering: Disable C.TRACK_TYPE_TEXT in ExoPlayer when DualSubtitleOverlay handles display.
AppVersionCard must use AuthManager's dynamic URL, NOT hardcoded BuildConfig.BASE_URL.
GetLatest app version API must handle empty DB gracefully — return baseline, not 404.
Parsing v2 HLS filenames with the newer '_at{audioTrackId}' field but old regex/index positions will misread MaxHeight and can generate impossible VAAPI scales like 2x1.
FShare CDN URLs can return HTTP 503 between playback-info generation and FFmpeg startup. Playback incidents may be upstream-provider failures even when HLS/session code is correct.
Directstream selected-audio remux to MP4 can fail for AC3 with 'Cannot write moov atom before AC3 packets'; fallback to HLS or adjust mux flags/container.
DV Profile 5 (IPT-PQ-C2) breaks zscale tonemap chain — assumes BT.2020nc matrix and causes green/magenta tint. Use tonemapx instead.
Placing scale filter BEFORE tonemapx corrupts HDR pipeline — swscale strips BT.2020 metadata. Always scale AFTER tonemap.
Intel Mesa Vulkan can fail libplacebo hwupload with VK_ERROR_INVALID_EXTERNAL_HANDLE — NVENC/libplacebo path only works on the right Vulkan stack.

Unbalanced or missing JSX tags (e.g., closing `

` logic mistakes inside ternary or logical && expressions) can silently break the compiler in Vite projects (producing bizarre parser failures within dependencies).

IPTV WebUI Playback: HLS streams from external domains will often fail on the web app due to CORS blocking `m3u8` or `.ts` resources. This is a client-side environment limitation that does not affect Android or TV apps where CORS is ignored.
PlayerView.keepScreenOn must be toggled in the update block (not the factory) and should be bound to !isPaused — binding to isPlaying alone lets the screen dim during buffering or brief stalls.

handleStreamEntry fires on every HLS segment fetch — any write-through side effect (progress, recent-channel bump, analytics) MUST be guarded by an in-memory dedupe window or it will hit the DB dozens of times per minute per viewer.
conventions: Use Netflix theme colors across Android app UI.
Material Icons Rounded style for all icons via LucideIcons alias object.
Responsive sizing: phone (<600dp) smaller cards/fonts; tablet original sizes.
Use track IDs, not just language codes, whenever selected audio/subtitle state has to survive round-trips between frontend, Android, and backend HLS sessions.
Feature rollout: default flag OFF (opt-in) for any change touching hot transcode path. Probe capability at startup, fall back to SW gracefully.

When integrating administrative operations globally (like download endpoints), keep Admin checks strictly in `RequireAdmin` middlewares rather than relying entirely on user flags context inside UI, ensuring full API security.
